in_sanskrit.name: अर्हित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is worthy or valuable. A title given to someone who has earned respect and recognition through his actions or qualities.

in_marathi.name: Arhith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arhith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arhaan means 'deserving' or 'worthy'. Itihas means 'history' or 'epic'. So, Arhith means 'one who is worthy of history' or 'one who makes history'.

in_bengali.name: Arhith
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Arhaan + Itihas
in_bengali.long_meaning: Arhith একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Arhaan means 'deserving' or 'worthy'. Itihas means 'history' or 'epic'. So, Arhith means 'one who is worthy of history' or 'one who makes history'.
